newsitem.title: USA: N.J. gives Newark schools $26 mln extra -- paper.
newsitem.headline: N.J. gives Newark schools $26 mln extra -- paper.

text.p: New Jersey Gov. Christine Whitman's administration has given the Newark School District $26 million in special aid, the Star Ledger reported Thursday.
The grant comes a week before the state Supreme Court is scheduled to review a new school funding formula that could cost Newark $34.1 million.
The city's schools superintendent, Beverly Hall, said the district would have faced a $30 million deficit next year without the aid.
School districts in Jersey City and Paterson, which like Newark are under state control, will receive special state grants of $13 million and $9 million, respectively, according to the paper.
